verdicts.reason: With a completed preview containing more values than the next workflow has fields, Workspace.tsx:82-84 clears dirty while controller.ts:81 retains the old view during the new run, so Workspace.tsx:591-592 indexes beyond workflow.fields and throws; the remove-column and four-to-three-column sample controls make that state reachable, though its incidence was not measured.

If an earlier File.arrayBuffer() rejects after cancel and a newer upload starts, controller.ts:190-191 invalidates the earlier request but its catch at 140-145 lacks the sequence guard present at 117 and clears the newer busy state; this ordering is reachable through cancel and retry, though rejection incidence was not measured.

Worker error, message error, and timeout handlers exist at controller.ts:38-45 and 83-89, while performance.spec.ts:66-112 exercises cancellation only and the other application tests contain no recovery-trigger tests, leaving the worker failure coverage required by the project plan absent; incidence was not measured.

If the bundled sample import fails after an active preview, controller.ts:58-60 keeps the prior view and clears busy, which satisfies Workspace.tsx:100 despite the error and causes configure(sampleConfig) at 102 against the old active file; a worker import error is a reachable trigger, though incidence was not measured.

When sample loading is cancelled after Workspace.tsx:88-90 installs and marks its workflow clean, controller.ts:190-202 retains the old active file and workflow, and retry at 209-210 reimports with that old workflow at 135, yielding a valid old export while Workspace.tsx:579 displays the sample headers; the cancel and retry controls make this ordering reachable, though incidence was not measured.
